text.S1: There once was a married man and woman who wished for a child. At length the woman hoped God was about to grant her desire. These people had a little window at the back of their house from which a splendid garden could be seen, which was full of the most beautiful flowers and herbs. It was surrounded by a high wall, which no one dared to pass, because it belonged to an evil enchantress who had great power and was dreaded by all the world.
text.T1: Kuciindi cimwi kwakali musankwa amukaintu bakakwetene bakali kulombozya kuba amwana. Ciindi nocakalmpa mukaintu wakalimvwa kuti Leza wakali kuyanda kumuvwiila kulombozya kwakwe. Aba bantu bobile bakajisi mpulungwindo kunze lya nganda yabo kwalo kwakali kulibonya mbewu yakali mbotu kapati, yakazwide maluba luba amichelo mibotu kapati. Yakali zingulukidwe abwaanda bulamfu, kwakali kakanyina naba omwe wakasunda kwiinda, nkaambo yakali yamulozi mubi cinicini wakajisi nguzu zinene wakali kuyoosya nyika yoonse.
text.T2: Ikaindi kwakali bantu bakakwetene bakali amuzeezo wakuba aamwana. Nokwakainda kaindi imukaintu wakalimvwa kuti Leza wakali kuyanda kumuvwiila kulombozya kwakwe. Ibantu aaba bakalijisi impulungwido kunze ya nganda yabo kwakali kubonekakela muunda mubotu, wakazulide imaluba luba mabotu amicelo. Yakali zingulukidwe abwaanda bulamfu, kwa kanyina muntu naba omwe wakalikusola kwiinda, nkaambo wakali wamulozi iwakajisi nguzu zinji alimwi wakali kuyoosya nyika yoonse mboizulwa.

text.S1: One day the woman, who was standing by the window and looking down into the garden, which was planted with the most beautiful flower, named rapunzel. It looked so fresh and so green she wanted it and had the greatest desire to eat it. This desire increased everyday, and as she knew that she could not have any, she quietly languished, and looked pale and tired.
text.T1: bumwi buzuba, mukaintu wakaimvwi ampulungwido kalanga ansi mumuunda, wakasyangidwe maluba mabotu, akaulikidwe zina lya rapunzel. Kwakali kuboneka kutete anyanzabili koonse wakakuyanda ooku akuyanda kuti biya aalye. Ooku kuyandisisya kwakaya ambele kuyaabuya mazuba, pele mboona mbwaakazyi kwaamba kuti eeci tiicaali kukokenzyeka, mukaumu-umu lyakamubeda penzi, kaboneka kutubuluka lukanda akulimvwa kukatal
text.T2: Bumwi buzuba imukaintu, wakali imvwii ambali aampulungwido kalanga mumuunda, iwakasyangidwe iluba libotu, lyakaulikidwe rapunzel. Lyakali kulibonya lya nguzu ilisiyasiya wakali kuliyanda alimwi wakalikulombozya kuti inga walilya. Ooku kuyandisisya kwakali kuya kumbele abuzuba, alimwi mbuli mbwakazyi kuti tanakali kukonzya kuba aalyo, wakapenga mu mizeezo akuboneka kutubuluka alimwi akukatala.

text.S1: She told the man: "If I can't get some of the rapunzel flower behind our house to eat, I shall die." And the man thought, “I will bring my wife some of the flower, let it cost what it will”. In the twilight of the evening, he clambered down over the wall into the garden of the evil enchantress, hastily grabbed a handful of rapunzels, and took them back to his wife. The woman made herself a salad of it, and ate it with joy.
text.T1: Wakaambila musankwa: “I kuti aalya maluba aali kunze angnda nketakonzyi kwaacela akwaalya, ndilafwa.” Nkabela musankwa wakayeeya, “Mwinangu ndamuletela aamwi alya maluba, kaciba biyo kufumwa eeco.” kucibbililo cazuba wakatanta akuselemuka abwaanda kunjila mumuunda wamulozi, akucela maluba manjaanji, mpoona wakaatola kumukaintu wakwe. Mukaintu wakabamba cakulya akulya cakukondwa.
text.T2: Wakaambila mwaalumi kuti, “Ikuti ndakakilwa kubweza luba lya rapuzel lili kunze kwang’anda kuti ndilye ndilafwa.” Mpoona mwaalumi wakayeeya, “mukaintu wangu ndilamuletela iluba, kufumbwa citicitike” Kumangolezya wakatanta bwaanda akunjila mumuunda wamulozi cakufwambaana akucela maluba aa rapunzell aazwide mumanza, akutolela mukaintu wakwe. Imukaintu wakabamba cilyo kuzwa kumaluba,akulya cakukondwa.

text.S1: She, however, liked it so much—so very much, that the next day she longed for it three times as much as before. Her husband must once more descend into the garden. In the gloom of evening, therefore, he let himself down again; but when he had clambered down the wall he was terribly afraid, for he saw the enchantress standing before him.
text.T1: Walo biya, wakaciyanda, cakuciyandisya, cakuti abuzuba bwakaccilila cakaindilila twiindi totatwe kuyandisya kwiinda kale. Mulumi wakwe weelede kuti alimwi biya ainke alimwi ku muunda. Mumudima wamangolozya, wakasotoka kuya ansi alimw; pele naakaseluka kubwaanda wakayoowa ciitaambiki, nkaambo wakazikubona mulozi kaimvwi munsi lyakwe.
text.T2: Walo wakaciyanda, ikuciyandisisya, cakuti abuzuba bwakacilila cakaindilila ziindi zyotatwe kwinda kaindi.imulumi wakwe weelede kunjila mumuunda alimwi. Mumusinze wamangolezya, alimwi wakaseluka akunjila mumuunda, pele naakaseluka bwaanda wakayoowa nkaambo wakabona mulozi ulimvwi munsi lyakwe.

text.S1: "How dare you," said the enchantress with a very angry look, "you descended into my garden and stole my rapunzels like a thief? You will suffer for it!" "Ah," answered the man. "Let mercy take the place of justice, I only made up my mind to do it out of necessity. My wife saw your flowers from the window, and felt such a longing for it she would have died if she had not had some."
text.T1: ‘’Ino kayi yebo,’’ wakaamba mulozi abusyu bwabukali, “wanjila mumuunda wangu akubba maluba angu mbuli mufumpi? Eeci calo ulacipengela!” “Ah,” wakavwiila musankwa. “Luse alwwinde cibeela camulawo, ndacita boobu nkaambo biyo cali kuyandika. Mukaintu wangu wakabona malubaluba kasondela ampulungwido, cakuti wakaba akuyandisya kupati cakuti naatakalya naanga wakafwa.”
text.T2: “Ino kayi yebo,” wakabwenta mulozi cabukali, “wanjila mumuunda wangu akubba maluba aangu mbuli mubbi? Eeci ulacipengela!” “Ah,” wakavwiiila mwaalumi. Amuleke lubomba lubweze cilao ca bululami, ndacita boobu nkaambo cali kuyandika. Mukaintu wangu wakabona maluba nakasondela ampulungwido, mpoona wakalimvwa kuyandisisya kulya maluba icakuti wakalimvwa kuti naa tana lya maluba ulafwa”

text.S1: Then the enchantress allowed her anger to be softened, and said to him, "If the case be as you say, I will allow you to take away with you as much rapunzel as you want, only I make a condition, you must give me the child which your wife will bring into the world. It will be well treated, and I will care for it like a mother." The man, in his terror, consented to everything, and when the woman was brought to bed, the enchantress appeared at once, named the child Rapunzel, and took her away.
text.T1: Mulozi wakajola kunyema kwakwe ansi, eelyo wakati kuli nguwe, “naa mboamba mbobwini, ndakuzuminzya kucela amwi maluba omwini kufumbwa ngoyandi, pesi buyo akaambo komwe, mweelede kundipa mwana mukaintu wako ngwayakutumbuka. Ndiyoomulela kabotu, akumulanganya mbuli banyina.” Nkaambo kakuyoowa kwakwe, uulya musankwa, wakazumina zyoonse, eelyo ciindi cakutumbuka nicakasika, mulozi wakabbuka cakufwambaana, akupa mwana zina kuti ngu Rapunzel, akumubweza.
text.T2: Mpoona bukali bwakajisi mulozi bwakamana, akumwambila kuti, “naa kuti kaambo mbokabede mbuli mboopandulula, ndilakuzumizya ikucela maluba manji kufumbwa ngoyanda, pele ndila kubikila mulawo, uyakundipa mwana ngwati ka zyale mukaintu wako. Ndiyakumubamba kabotu, ndiyakumubamba kabotu mbuli ba nyina.” Imulombwana, kwiinda mukuyoowa, wakazuminizya zyoonse zyakaambwa, mpoona imukaintu naaka tumbuka, imulozi wakalibonya mpoona mpoona, akuulika mwana Rapunzel, akumubweza.

text.S1: Rapunzel grew into the most beautiful child beneath the sun. The enchantress raised her as her daughter but treated her very cruely. When she was twelve years old, the enchantress locked her in a tower in a forest, which had neither stairs nor doors. At the top was a little window. When the enchantress wanted to climb in, she placed herself under it and cried, "Rapunzel, Rapunzel, Let down your hair to me." Rapunzel had magnificent long hair, and when she heard the voice of the enchantress she let down her braids, winding them round one of the hooks of the window above, and the enchantress climbed up.
text.T1: Rapunzel wakakomena akuba mwana wakaba mubotu cakweebeka nyika yoonse. Mulozi wakamukomenzya mwana musimbi uulya mbuli mwana wakwe pesi wakali alunya. Naakaba amyaka ili kkumi ayobile, muloozi wakajalila musimbi mukaanda akalamfu musyokwe, katakajisi malale nouba mulyango. Mpokali atla kakajisi kasena kaniini. Mulozi nakali kuyanada kunjila, wakalikulisinikizya mulinkako akoongogolola, akuti, “Rapunzel, Rapunzel kondipa masusu ako.’’ Rapunzel wakalijisi masusu mabotu malamfu kapati, nkabela naakamvwa ijwi lyamulozi wakaalekezya, akwaatambikizya akakobyo atala ampulungwido,uulya mulozi wakakkwela.
text.T2: Rapunzel wakakomena kuba mwana mubotu ansi aano. Imulozi wakamukomezya mbuli mwana wakwe pele wakali kumupenzya. Naakaba amyaka ikumi aa yobilo, imulozi wakamukkiila mu kaanda kalamfu musokwe, ikaanda katakajisi matantilo nouba mulyango. Atala akaanda kwakali mpulungwido. Imulozi naakali kuyanda kutanta akunjila, wakalisinikizya munsi akoongolola, kuti, “Rapunzel, Rapunzel, kondipa masusu aako.” Rapunzel wakalijisi masusu malamfu, mpoona naakamvwa ijwi lya mulozi wakalekezya masusu, akuazambaila ku ngobyo yomwe ya mpulungwido mujulu, mpoona imulozi wakatanta mujulu.

text.S1: After a few years locked in this tower.Rapunzel became miserable. She grew tired and bored of being locked away all these years. It came to pass that the King's son rode t shrough the forest and saw the tower. He heard a song, which was so charming that he stood still and listened. This was Rapunzel, who in her solitude passed her time in letting her sweet voice resound. The King's son wanted to climb up to see her and looked for the door of the tower, but none was to be found. He rode home, but the singing had so deeply touched his heart that every day he went out into the forest alone and listened to it. Once when he was standing behind a tree, he saw the enchantress arrive and he heard how she cried, "Rapunzel, Rapunzel, Let down your hair."
text.T1: Noyakaba myaka Rapunzel kajajalilidwe mukaanda kamujulu muya, wakalimvwa buumba. Wakalimvwa kukatala akulendelelwa mukaambo kakujalilwa myaka yoonse eeyi. Bumwi buzuba mwana wa Mwami wakli kuya kwiinda musyokwe mpoona wakabona kasanza kalamfu akaya. Wakamvwa lwiimbo, lwakali kukondelezya cakuti wakaima akuswiilila. Wakali Rapunzel, wakali kwiimba lyoonse mubundikke ajwi lyakwe linono. Mwana wa Mwami wakali kuyanda kutanta kuti amubone mpoona wakayandaula mulyango wakasanza, pele kwiina ngwaakabona. Wakainka kung’anda, pesi kwiimba kwakwe kwakamubotela akumujata kumumoyo cakuti abuzuba wakali kwiinka musokwe alikke akuswiilila. Bumwi buzuba kaimvwi kunze asamu, wakabona mulozi kasika alimwi wakamvwa kaongolola kati, “Rapunzel, Rapunzel, kolosya masusu.”
text.T2: Nokwakainda myaka misyoonto yakujalilwa mukaanda kalamfu kamujulu, Rapunzel wakalimvwa buumba akulendelelwa kaambo ka kujalilwa kwa myaka minjanj. Iciindi nocakasika, imwana wa mwami wakainda musokwe akubona kaanda kalamfu, wakamvwa kwiimba kwakali kukondelezya icakamupa kwiimikila mpoona mpoona akuswiilila. Ooyu wakali Rapunzel, iwakali kusowa ciindi kwiimba ajwi lyakwe libotu. Imwana wa mwami wakali kuyanda kutanata mujulu kuyoomubona wakalangaula mulyango wakaanda, pele kunyina ngwakajana. Wakapiluka kung’anda pele lwiimbo lwaka mujata moyo cakuti abuzuba wakali kuunka musokwe alike kuyooswilila lwiimbo. Cimwi ciindi naakaimvwi kunze lya cisamu, wakabona mulozi naakali kusika, mpoona wakaswiilila akumvwa mbwakalila, “Rapunzel, Rapunzel, kolosya masusu aako”

text.S1: Rapunzel let down the braids of her hair, and the enchantress climbed up to her. "I will do the same thing," he said, and the next day he went and cried, "Rapunzel, Rapunzel, Let down the hair." Immediately the hair fell down and the boy climbed up. At first Rapunzel was terribly frightened, by the man whose eyes she had never yet beheld. The King's son told her that in his heart he could have no rest, until he had saved her from the evil enchantress. Rapunzel lost her fear, and realized now she could escape the evil enchantress. And she said, "I will willingly go away with you, but I do not know how to get down. Bring with you a scarf of silk each time that you come here, and I will weave a ladder with it.”
text.T1: Rapunzel wakaalosya masusu, mpawo mulozi wakatanta kuya kuli nguwe. ‘’Ndila cita mbweena,” wakaamba, alimwi buzuba bwakaccilila wakaita, “Rapunzel, Rapunzel, kolosya masusu.” naakaloka biyo masusu musankwa wakatata. Akutaanguna Rapunzel wakayoowa kapati, nkaambo kameso amusankwa ngaatakana bona. Mwana wa Mwami wakaambila , musimbi kuti moyo wakwe kwiina nuunga wakkalikila kuti waalilwa kumugwasya kuzwa kumulozi. Aawa Rapunzel wakaleka kuyoowa akusyoma kuti eeyi njenzila yalikke njakonzya kutija mulozi mubi. Mpoona wakati, “ndazumina biya lwangu kwiinka anduwe, pele nsezi bwakuseluka. Wali kuboola kokuno lyoonse koboola aciteenge casuluku, eelyo ndiya koosa malale anjiyo.”
text.T2: Rapunzel wakalosya masusu aakwe aalukidwe, mpoona mulozi wakantanta mujulu kuya kuli nguwe. “Ndila cita mbubona buya, wakalisyomezya, mpoona ibuzuba bwaka cilila wakaunka akulila, “Rapunzel, Rapunzel, kolosya masusu aako.” Mpoona mpoona imasusu akaloka nkabela musankwa wakatanta mujulu. Kusanguna Rapunzel wakayoowa, nkaambo ka meso aamusankwa ngatana bwene. Imwana wa mwami wakamwambila kuti tanakali kukonzya kulyookezya, kusikila ciindi ncakonzya kumufutula kuzwa kumulozi. Rapunzel wakaleka kuyoowa, akusyoma kuti eeyi njenzila yalike njakonzya kutija kuzwa kumulozi. Mpoona wakaamba kuti, “Ndazumina amoyo omwe ikuunka anduwe, pele tandizhi mbwekonzya kuseluka. Wanikuboola lyoonse koletelezya mulembo wamumukosi, mpoona ndikoose aakutantila amulembo.”

text.S1: They agreed that he should come to her every evening, for the old woman came by day. The enchantress remarked nothing of this, until once Rapunzel said to her, "Tell me, mother, how it happens that you are so much heavier for me to draw up than the young King's son—he comes this evening." "Ah! you wicked brat," cried the enchantress "What do I hear you say! I thought I had separated you from all evil in the world, and now you have yet deceived me." In her anger she clutched Rapunzel's beautiful braids, wrapped them twice round her left hand, seized a pair of scissors with the right, and snip, snip, they were cut off, and the lovely braids lay on the ground. And she was so pitiless that she took poor Rapunzel into a desert where she had to live in great grief and misery.
text.T1: Bakazuminana kuti kaboola mangolezya mazuba oonse, nkaambo mucembele walo wakali kuboola biyo syikati. Mulozi kwiina ncaakali kwaamba kuli ceeci, kusikila limwi Rapunzel wakati kuli nguwe, “bbaama, amundaambile, cakuti nywebo mulalema kwiinda mwana wa Mwami kuya mujulu—ulaboola mangolezya sunu.” “Ah! Ocana cifubafuba yebo,” wakapozomoka mulozi, “waamba kuti nzi ncendamvwa! ndali kuti ndaakwaandanya kuzwa kuzibi zyanyika zyoonse yebo, pele wanduunina.” cabukali wakajata masusu akwa Rapunzel aakali mabotu, akwaazinga ziindi zyobilo kukwaanza kwakwe kwakulumwesyi akubweza kagele ajanza lyakululyo, mpoona cwe, cwe, akagelwa masusu akwe akali mabotu muzikuti akawida ansi. Taakajisi luse noluba luniini biyo nkabela wakatola Rapunzel mulukula nkwaakaakukkala mubuumba amapenzi mapati.
text.T2: Bakamvwana kuti kaboola lyoonse kumangolezya, nkaambo ikacembele kakali kuboola imasikati. Imulozi kunyina ncaakamba kuli ceeci, kusikila Rapunzel naakamwambila kuti, “Amundaambile, baama, mbuti mbomulema boobu ikumukwelela mujulu kwiiinda mwana wa mwami—ulasika kumangolezya.” “Ah! Okafubafuba,” wakalila mulozi “Waamba kuti nzi! Ndakali kuti ndakakutantamuna kuzwa kuzibi zyanyika zyoonse, mpoona yebo wandityompya. “Kwiinda mukunyema wakajata masusu aa Rapunael aalukidwe kabotu, akuazambaila kukwaanza kwaku lumwesi, akubweza kagele, akwaanza kwa kululyo,akugela, gela, mpoona imasusu mabotu akawida aansi. Wakanyema citaambiki akubweza mucaangu Rapunzel akumusowela musokwe nkwakali kuyookkala buuumba mumapenzi mapati.

text.S1: On the same day, however, that she cast out Rapunzel, the enchantress fastened the braids of hair which she had cut off to the hook of the window, and when the King's son came and cried,"Rapunzel, Rapunzel, Let down your hair," she let Rapunzel’s hair down. The King's son ascended, but he did not find the dearest Rapunzel above, but the evil enchantress, who gazed at him with wicked and venomous looks. "Aha!" she cried mockingly, "You would find my dearest, but the beautiful bird sits no longer singing in the nest; the cat has got it, and will poke out your eyes as well. Rapunzel is gone; you will never see her again."
text.T1: Nokuba boobu, mbubona buya buba mbwaakatanda Rapunzel, wakaangila makuti amasusu ngaakagela kuli Rapunzel kukajazyo kampulungwido, mpoona mwana wa Mwami naakasika wakoompolola kati, “Rapunzel,Rapunzel, kolosya masusu ako,” mulozi wakalosya masusu akwa Rapunzel. Mwana wa Mwami wakakkwela, pesi kwiina naakamujana muyandwa wakwe Rapunzel mujulu muya, pele biyo mulozi wakali kwiile kumulanga ameso akazwide buyosyi aluciso. “Aha!” wakaamba calweeno. “Uyoomujana muyandwa, pele muyuni tacikkede muciteente kaimba; kaaze wamutola, eelyo uyookukobbola meso ayebo. Rapunzel wakaunka; taaku noya kumubona alimwi.”
text.T2: Mbubona buzuba, mbakatanda Rapunzel, imulozi wakangilila masusu ngakatenda aalukidwe ku ndobyo ya mpulungwido, mpoona mwana wa mwami naakaboola akulila, . “Rapunzel, Rapunzel, kolosya masusu aako,” wakalosya masusu aa Rapunzel aansi. Imwana wa mwami wakatanta, pele tanakamujana muyandwa wakwe Rapunzel mujulu, pele imulozi, wakamulanga ameso mabi ayoosya “Aha! Wakalila cakunyasya, “Nomujana muyandwa, pele ikayuni kabotu kakkala takaciko takaciimbi mukanteente, ikakkiti kakaka bweza, mpoona kalaku ddonkola meso ayebo. Raapunzel wainka; tokamuboni limwi.”

text.S1: The King's son was beside himself with pain, and in his despair he leapt down from the tower. He escaped with his life, but the thorns into which he fell, pierced out his eyes. He wandered quite blind about in the forest, ate nothing, but roots and berries, and did nothing but lament and weep over the loss of his dearest love. Thus he roamed about in misery for some years, and at length came to the desert where Rapunzel lived in wretchedness. He heard a voice, and it seemed so familiar that he wept going towards it, and when he approached, Rapunzel knew him and fell to her knees and wept. Two tears wetted the prince’s eyes and they grew clear again, and he could see with them as before. He led her to his kingdom where he was joyfully received, and they lived for a long time afterwards, happy and content.
text.T1: Mwana wa Mwami wakasimpa kumvwa moyo kucisa, mpoona mubukali wakasotokela ansi lyakasanza. Wakatija muumi, pele mumamvwa mwaakawida, akayasa meso aakwe aku adonkola. Wakasweeka akweendauka saka lyoonse, katalyi, ccita biyo miyanda amicelo, kakunyina ncaakali kukonzya kucita pele biyo koombooka akulila kusweeka kwa muyandwa wakwe. Wakali kwiile kweendauka kwa myaka minji ceetezya, pele lyakainda ciindi wakasika kulukula kwakali kukkala Rapunzel mubusofwaazi. Wakamvwa jwi, eelyo lyakali kulitolezya mbuli ndyaakazi mpawo wakaliccilila kalila, nkabela naakasika afwaafwi, Rapunzel wakamuziba, eelyo wakaiwida kumaulu akwe wakalila. Misozi yakakunka kuzwa ku meso akwe obilo akutesya meso amwana wa Mwami mpoona wakabona alimwi mbli kaindi. Wakamutola kumunzi wakwe wabwami nkwaakatambulwa calutangalo, nkabakakkala kwaciindi cilamfu, cakukkomana , akuzulila.
text.T2: Imwana wa mwami wakali kkele alike mukupenga, abukali wakaseluka kuzwa mukaanda kalamfu. Wakatija, pele mamvwa aakli mpaakawida akamuyasa mumeso. Wakatalika kuzinguluka akoofwaala musokwe,kunyina ancaakali kulya, pele imiyanda aa malubbeni, alimwi kunyina cimbi ncaakali kucita pele kubwenta akulila akaambo kakusowa muyandwa wakwe. .Cakapa kuti kaile kweendauka kwa myaka minji, ceetezya, nokwakainda ciindi wakasika musokwe kwakali kukkala Rapunzel mu mapenzi. Wakamvwa ijwi, mpoona wakaliziba nakaswena munsimunsi cakuti wakalosya misozi. Imisozi zyobile zyakatesya meso aamwana wa mwami mpoona akaboneka kabotu alimwi, nkabela wakatalika kubona kabotu alimwi. Wakamutola kumunzi wakwe wabwami nkwaakatambulwa cakukkomana.
